baseline_models.reading: The focus presents plural runners in rapid motion, with an audible breath- or mouth-sound accompanying the run.

focus_anchor.role: The complete focus phrase joins the plural moving image to its accompanying sound.

activation_trace.role: The supplied branch gives running and hastening, including a horse's running.
The supplied sound image includes the audible breathing or mouth-sound of horses while running.

baseline_models.mechanism: The focus's plural running image and the supplied breath-sound image mutually specify a strenuous, audible movement rather than a bare statement of speed.
baseline_models.reader_inference: The packet supplies the running and breath-sound branches. Reading their juxtaposition as a plural scene of runners panting is ordinary lexical and syntactic inference; it does not identify the runners or require that they be a particular kind of animal.
baseline_models.containment: Keep this as the ordinary physical reading. It does not decide the referent of the plural or whether later images are literal continuations of the same agents.

context_deltas.reading: The focus's panting run becomes the opening beat of a tightly linked action sequence: movement proceeds into spark-producing action and a morning-raid image.

focus_anchor.role: The plural runners supply the initial motion whose sequel is tested against the following parallel phrases.

activation_trace.role: The next verse supplies the image of hidden fire coming out from a fire-stick.
Its paired root specifies striking out or kindling fire.
The supplied morning image explicitly includes a morning raid and its alarm.

structural_cues.role: The fa-linked parallel plural phrase follows the focus with a fire-striking action.
A second fa-linked parallel plural phrase carries the sequence into the morning.

context_deltas.mechanism: Successive fa-linked parallel phrases convert the focus from a self-contained sensory image into the first stage of escalating movement: breath, fire-producing action, then the supplied morning-raid register.

changed_reading.before: A self-contained depiction of runners panting.
changed_reading.after: The initial panting of a linked movement sequence that advances through spark-producing action to a morning-raid image.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the fire and morning-raid images. I infer continuity of action from the successive fa-linked feminine plural phrasing; the packet does not name the agents or settle whether every image is literal rather than figurative.
context_deltas.containment: Treat this as sequencing and intensification, not as a proof of one fixed historical scene or of the runners' identity.

context_deltas.reading: The opening run is no longer merely strenuous motion: its sequenced effects raise dust and reach the middle of an assembled body.

focus_anchor.role: The focus provides the moving force whose later effects make its direction consequential.

activation_trace.role: The following action is supplied as stirring something from its settled state, including raising dust or earth.
The object is supplied as raised or stirred dust.
The next action is supplied as entering into the middle of a group.
The ending object is supplied as an assembled group or mixed multitude.

structural_cues.role: The fa-linked clause presents dust as an effect of the preceding motion.
The subsequent fa-linked clause culminates in middle-entry and a gathering.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence gives the focus's velocity material consequences—disturbed ground and movement into a centre—so panting is read as the sensory onset of an incursion rather than ornamental exertion.

changed_reading.before: Fast, audible movement with no stated consequence.
changed_reading.after: Forward motion that visibly stirs dust and arrives at the middle of a gathered body.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies raised dust, entering the middle, and an assembled-group image. I infer a continuing moving subject across the fa-linked clauses; the referent of بِهِۦ and the precise kind of جمع remain open.
context_deltas.containment: Do not turn this into a claim about a named battle, target, or group. The reading is limited to the sequence's movement, dust, and centre-entry imagery.

context_deltas.reading: The intense external run can function as a foil for the later human diagnosis: energetic directedness is set beside ingratitude toward the Lord and intense attachment to what is named good.

focus_anchor.role: The audible strain of the run supplies the concentrated effort that can be set against the later moral description.

activation_trace.role: The Lord relation is supplied through lordship, ownership, and authority.
The human predicate is supplied as ingratitude toward favor, affection, and benefaction.
The later attachment is supplied as clinging love or preference.
What is loved is supplied broadly as desired good, benefit, virtue, or soundness.
The predicate supplies intensity, strength, and hardness.

structural_cues.role: After the action sequence, the text explicitly shifts to an evaluative statement about the human.
The human evaluation is continued by a statement of witnessing.
The next evaluative line names intense attachment to الخير.

context_deltas.mechanism: The movement vignette gives way to explicit human evaluation. Its exertion can therefore frame a contrast between powerful directed motion and a human direction of attachment described as ungrateful and intense.

changed_reading.before: An impressive physical run considered only as motion.
changed_reading.after: A possible framing foil for a human whose relation to the Lord is called ungrateful and whose attachment to named good is called intense.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the shift to الإنسان, ingratitude, witnessing, love, good, and intensity. Calling the opening a foil is a reader-supplied structural inference; neither the runners' identity nor a particular material referent for الخير is stated.
context_deltas.containment: Present this as a literary contrast, not an allegory that identifies the runners with humans or equates الخير with wealth.

context_deltas.reading: The focus's external breath-sound can be read as the first sensory layer in an exploratory movement from exposed surfaces to upturned graves, disclosed chests, and the Lord's inward knowledge.

focus_anchor.role: The focus gives an audible exterior sign of motion from which the later disclosure pattern is provisionally traced.

activation_trace.role: The later image supplies overturning earth and uncovering what was buried.
The supplied image is collecting until an outcome is clear, including revealing what is in breasts.
The object is supplied as the bodily chest or breast.
The closing predicate supplies tested knowledge of the inner rather than merely outward appearance.

structural_cues.quote_ar: ۞ أَفَلَا يَعْلَمُ إِذَا بُعْثِرَ مَا فِى ٱلْقُبُورِ
structural_cues.role: The late question introduces the upturning of what is in graves.
It immediately continues with what is in chests being brought to account.
The ending grounds the disclosure in the Lord's knowledge of them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening is sensory and external, while the ending explicitly moves through buried contents and chests to inward knowledge. Reading this as an outer-to-inner disclosure arc makes the focus an opening surface, without changing its ordinary motion sense.

changed_reading.before: An isolated audible sign of fast movement.
changed_reading.after: The exterior sensory threshold of a possible sequence that culminates in disclosure of what is buried and inward.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the physical opening, graves, chests, and knowledge of inner matters. The directional outer-to-inner arc is my inference; a live alternative is that the final accountability section simply changes topic after the oath imagery.
context_deltas.containment: Do not claim that each opening image allegorizes a bodily or moral layer. Retain this only as a qualified compositional possibility.

surprising_valid_outliers.reading: Alongside the ordinary breath-sound, a supplied scorch branch can let the focus carry a contained heat resonance when the next verse pairs hidden fire with striking it out.

focus_anchor.role: The focus sound is the site where the unexpected scorch image is tested without displacing its ordinary sense.

activation_trace.role: A supplied focus branch gives scorching the top of wood and fire-striker stones.
The immediately following image gives hidden fire emerging from a fire-stick.
The paired word supplies striking or kindling fire.

structural_cues.role: The directly following fa-linked phrase concentrates the fire imagery.

surprising_valid_outliers.mechanism: The nonordinary scorch branch belongs to the focus root, and the adjacent verse independently doubles fire imagery. Their adjacency permits a fire-adjacent overtone around the panting sound while leaving the baseline intact.

changed_reading.before: The focus sound is read only as audible panting.
changed_reading.after: Panting remains primary, but a secondary heat-and-spark resonance becomes locally available.

surprising_valid_outliers.reader_inference: The packet supplies both the alternate scorch branch and the next verse's fire branches. I infer resonance from adjacency; nothing says that the breath literally burns or that the runners themselves generate the fire.
surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the ordinary focus branch is a breath-sound. Keep it as a subordinate overtone, never as a replacement literal translation.

surprising_valid_outliers.reading: A distinct-form mapped branch permits a cautious image of the focus's running as practiced or recurrent exertion; beside the later human diagnosis, this can suggest habitual energy whose direction is ethically unsettled.

focus_anchor.role: The plural moving form is the visual anchor for the proposed recurrent-motion resonance.

activation_trace.role: The packet maps the focus root to a distinct-form target whose supplied image is habit, practiced familiarity, and repeated engagement.
The later human condition includes ingratitude, forgetting favors, and self-serving behavior.
The later human attachment is supplied as persistent love or preference.
Its intensity is supplied as strength, hardness, and exertion.

structural_cues.role: The later human diagnosis provides the ethical pressure for testing a habitual-motion resonance.
The later assertion supplies a strongly attached human disposition.

surprising_valid_outliers.mechanism: The focus map retains a distinct ع و د-form target rather than collapsing it into the ordinary running branch. Its habit image can therefore resonate with recurrent exertion, while the later moral statements make the direction of habitual intensity a live question.

changed_reading.before: A single visible burst of running.
changed_reading.after: A cautiously available image of trained or recurrent exertion, set beside ethically charged human attachment.

surprising_valid_outliers.reader_inference: The packet explicitly marks this target as a distinct-form mapping (ع و د) and supplies its habit branch. I supply the analogy between recurrent running and human habit; the later lines motivate but do not compel it, and they do not identify the runners as humans.
surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a branch-distant outlier. Do not treat the surface form as literally meaning habit, or turn the ethical juxtaposition into a settled identification of runners with people.

summary.ordinary_reading: 100:1 ordinarily presents plural runners in rapid motion with an audible breath- or mouth-sound.
coexisting_readings: The fa-linked sequence can make that breathy motion the opening of a spark, dawn, dust, and centre-entry action rather than an isolated image.
The later human evaluation can function as a qualified foil for the opening's concentrated exertion, without identifying the runners with humans.
Exploratorily, the focus can serve as an exterior sensory threshold before the final disclosure of graves and chests; its heat and recurrent-habit resonances remain subordinate outliers.
unresolved_limits: The packet records no source_gaps, but it does not name the runners, determine the referent of بِهِۦ, or fix the particular gathered body in 100:5.
The physical sequence may be literal, figurative, or mixed; the packet's non-citable orientation adds no evidence for choosing among those possibilities.
Distinct-form mappings, especially the ع و د habit target, are preserved as exploratory possibilities and must not be collapsed into the ordinary focus sense.
